notes:
Fixes update preparation incorrectly reporting that local draft recovery could not be confirmed when the stored draft is complete.

- Confirm sharded recovery by JSON content, preserving every value and array order while allowing object properties to be reconstructed in a different order.
- Keep explicit draft confirmations safe when background autosave runs during update preparation or tab closure.
- Keep the app open if later persistence or readback fails, with retry guidance that does not incorrectly claim local storage is full.

If an installed 0.1.3 or 0.1.4 app is blocked by this recovery message, install this release manually once: save unfinished work to the workspace, quit Rove, then run the Windows installer or replace the Mac application using the DMG. Do not clear application storage. The fix takes effect in 0.1.5 for future update preparation; a release feed cannot change the updater code already running in an older app.

Includes the Bruno import improvements from 0.1.4. This remains an optional update for supported versions; the minimum supported version stays 0.1.1.

Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon packages come from the same source commit. Updater payloads use the existing Rove update key. macOS uses ad-hoc platform signing; Apple notarization and Windows certificate signing are not included in this beta. Disposable browser and source tests do not establish an installed-app migration test on both platforms.
